name: quagmire-i
message: The Quag One is a periodic cipher with a keyed plain alphabet run against a straight cipher alphabet.
note: Published ACA Quagmire I worked example, page 71. Plaintext keyword SPRINGFEV(ER) normalizes to SPRINGFEVER; repeats are removed when building the alphabet. Indicator FLOWER sits under plaintext A. The ciphertext alphabet is straight A-Z. Spaces, grouping, and punctuation are omitted from the stored letter streams and plaintext hash. Known-key verification only, not an unknown-script reading or a solution of Kryptos K4, Zodiac, Beale, McCormick, Voynich, or army message Nr. 86.
